# 自然科學探究與實作 / Science Inquiry and Practice: course outline

**Version 1, 2026-11-16.** 3 parts, 9 chapters, about 6 hours of lessons.  
Core: 0 parts, 0 chapters. Tracks: sprint-116.  
Papers: science. Paths: 自然 (`science`). Status: active.

## Decisions

- 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required science in school; full lessons follow for 117.
- Owner (2026-11-27): s116-inq-argue-model takes math/s116-data-analysis as a prereq, because it uses scatter diagrams, the correlation coefficient and the regression line from it.
- Owner requirement (2026-11-16): a cross-subject part after the subject units, analysing one context with physics, chemistry, biology and earth science.
- Exam-tested skills beyond the 必修 text (Lenz, dimensional analysis, ionic-equation balancing) are taught in physics/s116-induction, physics/s116-physics-reasoning and chemistry/s116-redox, each justified by a verified past item; the exam toolkit chapter is a cross-subject drill that recaps them with links and mixes new practice (owner, 2026-11-27).
- Practice papers are original and only modelled on the 111–115 layout; official papers are linked, never copied.
- Owner approved the 自然 sprint outline (2026-11-16): keep the 60-chapter size; write ONE subject at a time (rate limits); biology relies on the shared inquiry exam-skills part; the shared 自然 mock is the only science practice paper; environment-energy stays one chapter.

### Part 0: 探究與實作 / Inquiry and practice (track sprint-116)

**Question:** 科學家怎麼從一個現象走到一個可信的結論？ / How does a scientist get from a phenomenon to a conclusion you can trust?  
**Track:** 116 學測衝刺 / GSAT 116 sprint. Starts after (anywhere): 給已在學校修過自然科學探究與實作與必修物理、化學、生物、地球科學，準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。 / For students who took 自然科學探究與實作 and the required physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.  

*Why here:* Verified earth-inquiry units 27–31: overview, then 發現問題 → 規劃與研究 → 論證與建模 → 表達與分享 (depends_on chain 28→29→30→31), with the planner's 學習表現 mapping (po/ti → 發現問題, pe → 規劃與研究, pa/tr/tm → 論證與建模, pc/tc/ah/an → 表達與分享). Unit 27: no 地科 prerequisite and it can be taught before or alongside the subject units, so this part has no cross-subject prereqs. Correction: some 考試說明 items target 探究與實作 alone (外傘頂洲 Q1), so it gets its own review. Strands 1–2 are merged into one chapter (both short, and 113 Q43 tests them together).

### Part 1: 跨科解題 / Cross-subject problem solving (track sprint-116)

**Question:** 同一個現象，四科各看到什麼？ / What does each of the four subjects see in the same phenomenon?  
**Track:** 116 學測衝刺 / GSAT 116 sprint. Starts after (anywhere): 給已在學校修過自然科學探究與實作與必修物理、化學、生物、地球科學，準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。 / For students who took 自然科學探究與實作 and the required physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.  

*Why here:* Owner requirement: a cross-unit lesson after all subject units. Verified: every year 112–115 Part 2 had cross-subject 題組 (112 物/地 Q51–54; 113 物/生 Q40–43 and 化/地 Q50–53; 114 生/地 Q40–43; 115 生/化 Q40–43 and 地/物 Q50–53). Real 題組 pair two subjects; the four-subject analysis is our teaching design, not an exam claim. Placed after the inquiry part because the analysis uses its strands; its first chapter takes every terminal review chapter of the four subject courses as prereqs, so every subject review chapter is an ancestor (sprint review → sprint review; the subjects' exam-skills chapters cannot be cross-subject prereqs under the structure rule).
